# U059 reference-redrawn labels

Updated 2026-10-26. Rear DC MOTOR label. Exact operating front has no printed label; eccentric remains a moving physical solid. The exact SKU has no supplied original in the source lookup, so readable same-SKU official print was independently reconstructed under the user's authorization. These final 1024 px wide PNGs and their model surfaces are explicitly `reference-redraw`.

Copy reproduced: DC MOTOR, N20, PORT.B.I/O, OUT / 5V / GND. No product-photo crop, skewed photographic plane or copied bitmap fragment is used. Font and symbol outlines are visual reconstructions. No unrelated HAT/Module artwork is substituted.

- [Exact official photograph](https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/vibrator/vibrator_02.webp) — SHA-256 `eacd98a22437876757930a6b1aadc481a4d6dbfd2970fe8da3b35c565cb12b13`.

`artwork:false` removes all labels. [sticker-check.json](./sticker-check.json) verifies exact shared pre-edit physical and API signatures for both Model and GroveModule, artwork opt-out, preserved visual actions, mounting/connector openings, four-wire pose/attach/detach and resource release. Real eccentric rotates at requested RPM; shell/rear label/Grove fixed; exact reset.

Remaining boundaries:

- Font shapes, colors, small icon outlines and sticker XYZ are reconstructed from exact official photos; no manufacturing-artwork or production-fit claim.
- Packaging, private originals, mappings, source links from the table, vectors, generators and intermediates are excluded.
- No browser, exhaustive face inspection or full suite; original modeled stage retained.
- The visible legacy OUT legend is copied verbatim. Existing DIN/NC connector metadata and visual rotor API remain unchanged; the label does not implement or reinterpret electrical behavior.
